snippet.title: The Silence: The Forest Trailer 2 (PC)
snippet.description:
The Silence is a new horror experience where you must collect lost items to escape the deep woods, but something is watching you from the shadows. He is following you all the time... and if he catches you, the silence will be eternal

Don't look back. Don't stop running. Can you survive the night?

#horror #horrorgame #indiegame #thesilencetheforest
